sources.snippet: Offline AI Video Generator is a modular pipeline that automatically creates short-form videos using local AI models. It combines multiple components—language generation, text-to-speech, image generation, subtitle alignment, and video rendering—into a fully offline workflow. Ideal as a demonstration of practical AI integration, media generation, and automation systems in a real-world scenario.
